const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); # You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [-101.55, 29.20],
      [-100.70, 29.20],
      [-100.70, 29.80],
      [-101.55, 29.80],
      [-101.55, 29.20]
    ], null, false);

    const periods = [
      {label: '2016-08', start: '2016-08-01', end: '2016-09-01'},
      {label: '2024-08', start: '2024-08-01', end: '2024-09-01'}
    ];
    const widenDays = { pre: 15, post: 15 }; // widen by +-15 days if needed
    const waterThresh = 0.10; // MNDWI threshold
    const reduceScale = 1000; // per guidelines
    const maxPixels = 1e9;
    const roiAreaKm2 = ee.Number(roi.area(1)).divide(1e6).getInfo();

    // 2. Helpers
    function prepL89(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))      // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))      // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0));     // cloud shadow
      const scaled = img.select(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6'], ['green', 'swir1'])
        .multiply(2.75e-05).add(-0.2)
        .updateMask(mask);
      const mndwi = scaled.normalizedDifference(['green', 'swir1']).rename('mndwi');
      return scaled.addBands(mndwi);
    }

    function getLandsatCollection(start, end) {
      const l8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi).map(prepL89);
      const l9 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi).map(prepL89);
      return l8.merge(l9);
    }

    function prepS2(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA60');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0) // clouds
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0));     // cirrus
      const scaled = img.select(['B3', 'B11'], ['green', 'swir1']).multiply(1e-4).updateMask(mask);
      const mndwi = scaled.normalizedDifference(['green', 'swir1']).rename('mndwi');
      return scaled.addBands(mndwi);
    }

    function getS2Collection(start, end) {
      // Prefer SR (L2A) if available; otherwise fallback to TOA (L1C)
      const startYear = parseInt(start.slice(0,4), 10);
      const srOK = startYear >= 2017;
      const colId = srOK ? 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR' : 'COPERNICUS/S2';
      return ee.ImageCollection(colId).filterDate(start, end).filterBounds(roi).map(prepS2);
    }

    function widenRange(startStr, endStr) {
      const start = ee.Date(startStr).advance(-widenDays.pre, 'day');
      const end = ee.Date(endStr).advance(widenDays.post, 'day');
      return { start: start.format('YYYY-MM-dd'), end: end.format('YYYY-MM-dd') };
    }

    function computeStats(col) {
      const n = col.size();
      const composite = ee.Image(col.median()).clip(roi);
      const validMask = composite.select('green').mask();
      const validArea = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(validMask)
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: reduceScale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels
        }).get('area');
      const validAreaKm2 = ee.Number(validArea).divide(1e6);

      const water = composite.select('mndwi').gt(waterThresh).rename('water');
      const waterArea = water.updateMask(water)
        .multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea())
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: reduceScale,
          maxPixels: maxPixels
        }).get('water');

      // Also compute valid pixel count at coarse scale for QC
      const validCount = composite.select('green').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: reduceScale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('green');

      return {
        n: n,
        validAreaKm2: validAreaKm2,
        waterAreaKm2: ee.Number(waterArea).divide(1e6),
        validCount: ee.Number(validCount)
      };
    }

    async function evaluateStats(label, start, end) {
      // Try Landsat
      let col = getLandsatCollection(start, end);
      let n = col.size().getInfo();
      let widened = false;
      if (n === 0) {
        const widenedRange = widenRange(start, end);
        col = getLandsatCollection(widenedRange.start.getInfo ? widenedRange.start.getInfo() : widenedRange.start,
                                   widenedRange.end.getInfo ? widenedRange.end.getInfo() : widenedRange.end);
        n = col.size().getInfo();
        widened = true;
      }
      // If still empty, try Sentinel-2
      let usedS2 = false;
      if (n === 0) {
        let s2 = getS2Collection(start, end);
        let n2 = s2.size().getInfo();
        if (n2 === 0) {
          const widenedRange = widenRange(start, end);
          s2 = getS2Collection(widenedRange.start.getInfo ? widenedRange.start.getInfo() : widenedRange.start,
                               widenedRange.end.getInfo ? widenedRange.end.getInfo() : widenedRange.end);
          n2 = s2.size().getInfo();
          widened = true;
        }
        if (n2 === 0) {
          return { label, empty: true };
        }
        col = s2;
        n = n2;
        usedS2 = true;
      }

      const stats = computeStats(col);
      const out = ee.Dictionary({
        label: label,
        n: n,
        widened: widened,
        usedS2: usedS2,
        validAreaKm2: stats.validAreaKm2,
        waterAreaKm2: stats.waterAreaKm2,
        validCount: stats.validCount
      }).getInfo();

      // Validation: C2/C3 checks
      const vArea = out.validAreaKm2;
      const wArea = out.waterAreaKm2;
      if (vArea === null || wArea === null || isNaN(vArea) || isNaN(wArea)) {
        return { label, calcFail: true };
      }
      if (vArea <= 0) {
        return { label, noValidPixels: true, n: out.n, widened: out.widened, usedS2: out.usedS2 };
      }

      const cloudFreePct = (vArea / roiAreaKm2) * 100.0;

      return {
        label,
        n: out.n,
        widened: out.widened,
        usedS2: out.usedS2,
        validAreaKm2: vArea,
        waterAreaKm2: wArea,
        cloudFreePct: cloudFreePct
      };
    }

    // 3. Run for both periods
    console.log(`ROI area (km²): ${roiAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Water classification: MNDWI > ${waterThresh.toFixed(2)}`);

    const s1 = await evaluateStats(periods[0].label, periods[0].start, periods[0].end);
    const s2 = await evaluateStats(periods[1].label, periods[1].start, periods[1].end);

    // 4. Handle data availability issues
    if (s1 && s1.empty || s2 && s2.empty) {
      if (s1 && s1.empty) console.log(`${periods[0].label} Images: 0`);
      if (s2 && s2.empty) console.log(`${periods[1].label} Images: 0`);
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (s1 && s1.calcFail || s2 && s2.calcFail) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (s1 && s1.noValidPixels || s2 && s2.noValidPixels) {
      if (s1 && s1.noValidPixels) console.log(`${periods[0].label} Images: ${s1.n} (No valid pixels after masking)`);
      if (s2 && s2.noValidPixels) console.log(`${periods[1].label} Images: ${s2.n} (No valid pixels after masking)`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Print concise evidence
    const line1 = `${periods[0].label} Images: ${s1.n}` + (s1.widened ? ' [widened]' : '') + (s1.usedS2 ? ' [S2]' : '');
    const line2 = `${periods[0].label} ValidArea(km²): ${s1.validAreaKm2.toFixed(1)} Cloud-free(%ROI): ${s1.cloudFreePct.toFixed(1)}`;
    const line3 = `${periods[0].label} WaterArea(km²): ${s1.waterAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`;

    const line4 = `${periods[1].label} Images: ${s2.n}` + (s2.widened ? ' [widened]' : '') + (s2.usedS2 ? ' [S2]' : '');
    const line5 = `${periods[1].label} ValidArea(km²): ${s2.validAreaKm2.toFixed(1)} Cloud-free(%ROI): ${s2.cloudFreePct.toFixed(1)}`;
    const line6 = `${periods[1].label} WaterArea(km²): ${s2.waterAreaKm2.toFixed(1)}`;

    const diff = s2.waterAreaKm2 - s1.waterAreaKm2;
    const diffPct = (diff / Math.max(1e-6, s1.waterAreaKm2)) * 100.0;
    const line7 = `ΔWater 2024-2016 (km²): ${diff.toFixed(1)} (${diffPct.toFixed(1)}%)`;

    console.log(line1);
    console.log(line2);
    console.log(line3);
    console.log(line4);
    console.log(line5);
    console.log(line6);
    console.log(line7);

    // 6. Final Answer
    if (!isFinite(diff) || isNaN(diff)) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (diff < 0) {
      console.log('A'); // Yes: decreased
    } else {
      console.log('B'); // No: not decreased
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}
